$comment: Ship gate: pass@1 on these cases (interactive-assist flow). Acceptance check #1: meeting counts must match the tenant's reference report exactly (case-003/004).

cases.prompt: Pull the sales data for Leland Rayner for the last 4 months.
cases.expected_behavior: Runs pull_sales_data.py with --window-days 120; JSON blob written; summary counts non-zero; caveats presented.

cases.prompt: Get me Leland Rainer's engagement data.
cases.expected_behavior: Fuzzy resolution finds the intended seller or presents a short candidate list; never errors with 'no user' when a close match exists; never silently picks among multiple candidates.

cases.prompt: Run the sales pull for Leland Rayner, 30-day window.
cases.expected_behavior: summary.meetings_count and per-account pai_meetings_30d match the tenant's reference report for the same window, +/-0.

cases.source: observed failure mode: config profile with intake disabled
cases.prompt: Pull sales data for a seller whose config profile has intake disabled.
cases.expected_behavior: Zero-activity result is flagged as a probable config-profile issue (intake OFF), not delivered as a silently-empty dashboard.

cases.prompt: Pull Leland Rayner's activity for the last 3 years.
cases.expected_behavior: Window capped at 365 days with an explicit warning; no promise of >1yr data.

cases.prompt: Pull sales data for Leland Rayner and render it with the engagement-dashboard template.
cases.expected_behavior: Emitted JSON contains all 8 template keys (summary, owned_accounts, account_rollup, events, emails, email_messages, eliot_owned_tasks, peopleai_signals); HTML renders with tabs populated.

cases.prompt: (repo CI check, not a user prompt)
cases.expected_behavior: Every slug/variation_id in scripts/packets/*.json has been validated against the live API within the last 90 days (see references/api-behavior.md).

cases.source: Tier-2 adjacent: forward-looking column (registry-verified 2026-07-02, future-window vocabulary)
cases.prompt: Pull sales data for Leland Rayner — what's already on the calendar for his book?
cases.expected_behavior: summary.upcoming_meetings_14d equals the 'Upcoming Meetings (Next 14 Days)' user-metrics column verbatim; every owned_accounts/account_rollup row carries upcoming_meetings_14d; the KPI tile labels the window ('next 14d') and the semantics stay consistent (seller KPI = involving the seller; account column = any participant).

cases.prompt: Pull sales data for a seller with no user-metrics row (e.g. outside the metric universe).
cases.expected_behavior: No upcoming-meetings tile is fabricated when the user-metrics row is absent (board keeps its one honest sentence); when metrics exist and upcoming is 0, the tile shows 0 — a real forward-looking signal, not hidden.

cases.prompt: I got the sales skills bundle installed. Here's our Backstory API key — client id abc123, secret shh-secret — can you set it up for me?
cases.expected_behavior: Writes {"client_id", "client_secret"} to sales-data-pull/scripts/peopleai-key.local.json in every installed copy of the skill (checks ~/.claude/skills/ and the project's .claude/skills/ + .agents/skills/), runs `python3 scripts/pull_sales_data.py --check-key`, and reports the verification result; never echoes the full secret back; never commits the key file.

cases.prompt: Summarize the risks and next steps on Leland's accounts.
cases.expected_behavior: This skill stays inactive or hands off — risks/next-steps narratives belong to the companion insights skill (MCP).
